About Me

Hi, I'm Libi. I'm a 17 years old student living in Limassol, Cyprus. I am a dedicated and devoted student driven by a pursuit of excellence in my scholastic endeavours, creative projects, and entrepreneurial initiatives.

I love working with kids, and am heavily experienced amongst all age groups. As well as babysitting, I actively lead a Scouts troop, cultivating my management skills through fostering guidance to the youth and orchestrating large-scale, logistics-heavy outdoor activities.

I speak fluent English and Hebrew, with A* IGCSE certifications to support both endeavours. Most importantly, I come with an approach to connect and to foster enjoyment amongst the kids beyond the language they speak.
